jobs.occupation: Senior Engineer - Financial Services
jobs.description:
💰 🇩🇰 up to 57,000 DKK/month gross _(varies by seniority)

_Intro

Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you'll do well with us.

AI is not a nice-to-have at Monta. It's how we work. Engineers use Claude Code daily. We ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean because of it. We expect everyone to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI, not just use it passively.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people: sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You'll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Financial Services team, the team responsible for every euro that flows through Monta's platform. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role where you'll own the architecture and delivery of complex financial systems, working across teams to ensure we can scale reliably as we expand across Europe.

Financial Services is at an inflection point. Our transaction volume is growing fast and already processes millions of euros each month. We're building the next generation of our financial infrastructure, including new billing models and compliance capabilities to support expansion into new EU markets. The problems are hard, the stakes are real, and the work matters.

We need someone who takes full ownership of what they build. Not someone who waits for direction, but someone who sees what needs to happen, drives it forward, and delivers. You will own projects end-to-end, from technical design through to production, and you'll be accountable for outcomes, not just output.

You should also be someone who has embraced AI as a core part of how you work. We use Claude Code extensively across the Financial Services team for everything from writing and reviewing code to designing systems and exploring financial domain problems. We expect you to be an advanced AI user who actively finds new ways to leverage these tools to move faster and think better.

This Is What You Will Achieve

• Redesign Monta's financial backbone. You'll architect and build the new invoicing system that every customer will use, replacing the current infrastructure with a foundation built for serious scale.

• Unblock EU expansion. You'll build the compliance infrastructure (e-invoicing, fiscalization, VAT) that enables Monta to enter new European markets.

• Strengthen the money flow. You'll improve the reliability and scalability of payment processing, reconciliation, and withdrawal systems across a rapidly growing transaction volume.

What You Will Do

• Own the new invoice system end-to-end. Design and deliver a new invoicing architecture that supports multiple billing models and financial flows as the business scales into new markets.

• Build and scale compliance infrastructure. E-invoicing across European markets. Fiscalization integrations. A VAT engine that handles the complexity of cross-border EV charging.

• Improve payment flows from card to payout. Card payments, automated reconciliation, withdrawal reliability, and working capital management.

• Collaborate across Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and Product to deliver new billing and commercial models. You won't work in a silo.

• Drive architecture decisions for systems that must be right. Every euro must be traceable from summary down to line item. You'll design for auditability, correctness, and scale.

• Elevate the team around you. Contribute to the growth of the Financial Services engineering team through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing.

What We're Looking For

• Strong backend engineering experience. You've built and maintained production systems at scale. Java/Kotlin preferred, but strong engineers from other stacks are welcome.

• Experience with financial systems. Billing, invoicing, payment processing, or similar domains where correctness and reliability are non-negotiable.

• Proven ability to own architecture across teams. You don't just write code, you shape systems. You've led technical design for complex projects that span multiple teams.

• A strong sense of ownership. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks. When something needs to happen, you make it happen. You don't wait to be asked.

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity. Regulatory landscapes shift, business models evolve, and priorities change. You bring structure where there is none.

• Curiosity about financial infrastructure. Invoicing, VAT, compliance, payment flows. You don't need to be a domain expert on day one, but you're eager to go deep.

• Advanced AI adoption. You already use AI tools daily in your engineering workflow and you're always looking for new ways to apply them. You don't just accept suggestions, you prompt deliberately, iterate on output, and integrate AI into how you design, build, and debug.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, finance, legal, and product. You build alignment fast and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders.

**Bonus

**

• Experience with EU financial regulations, e-invoicing standards, or fiscalization

• Experience with payment service providers or payment infrastructure

• Familiarity with event-driven architectures (Kafka) or high-throughput data processing

**If the mission excites you but your experience isn't a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway. We care about potential, not perfection.

**AI at Monta Engineering

• AI is central to how we build software at Monta. It's not a side experiment. It's embedded in our daily work and we expect every engineer to be a power user.

• Tools we use daily:

• Claude Code for writing, reviewing, and refactoring code, exploring domain problems, and building internal tooling

• Claude / Gemini for research, design thinking, and documentation

• Notion AI for docs, knowledge management, and meeting notes

• AI-enhanced testing and monitoring

We expect you to bring a strong opinion on how to use AI effectively in engineering. If you've built custom workflows, pushed the limits of agentic coding, or found creative ways to use LLMs in your development process, you'll fit right in.

Why Monta

• Impact, not easy mode. Your work matters, and you'll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one. We don't micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The people are extraordinary. Talented, driven, and fun to work with. You'll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure.

What We Offer

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life's big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you're at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

Please send us your application in English.

To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you'll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don't accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won't agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

jobs.occupation: Senior Software Engineer – OCaml/C# – OTC Core
jobs.description:
**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values - caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like **what we’re saying, keep reading!

****About Otc Core

**In the OTC Core Product Area, we work on functionality supporting over-the-counter financial instruments in SimCorp’s main product, SimCorp Dimension. Our work brings together financial contract modelling, functional programming, and C#/.NET development.

Most of our development work centres on financial contract models written in an internally developed domain-specific language embedded in OCaml. These models bring together business logic, database mapping, and user-interface layout in one place. Alongside implementing the models, we evolve the language itself and the supporting C#/.NET framework.

You do not need to arrive as an expert in OTC instruments or OCaml. What matters is curiosity about the problems, strong programming foundations, and a willingness to learn.

**What You Will Work On

**As part of a cross-functional team working across locations, you will contribute from the first discussion of a feature through design, implementation, testing, and support.

You will:

• Implement financial contract models in our OCaml-based domain-specific language, defining their business logic, database mapping, and user-interface layout.

• Evolve the OCaml-based language and supporting C#/.NET framework, balancing new capabilities with improvements to existing code.

• Use AI-assisted development tools - including Claude, GitHub Copilot, and our internally developed cloud agent - to explore solutions, develop code, and improve tests, applying your engineering judgment to validate the results.

• Work with product management and fellow engineers to understand business needs and turn them into maintainable solutions.

• Build automated tests and use code reviews to improve correctness, clarity, and maintainability.

• Help make technical decisions, address technical debt, and share your experience with colleagues.

**What You Bring

**We are primarily looking for a senior engineer who can work through complex problems, contribute to design decisions, and collaborate effectively with others.

We value:

• Strong programming and software design skills, with experience in C#/.NET or functional programming.

• The ability to understand an existing system and make thoughtful, well-tested changes.

• Curiosity about functional programming, financial modelling, and the business problems behind the code.

• A collaborative approach: asking questions, explaining your reasoning, and giving and receiving constructive feedback.

• Clear communication in English and a willingness to keep learning.

Experience with OCaml or other functional languages (Haskell, Scala, F#, or similar), domain-specific languages, Web APIs, or financial software would be useful - but you do not need to bring all of it. A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience can provide a foundation; we are interested in what you can do and how you approach problems.

**Benefits

**

• Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.

• Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.

• Self- Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.

• Inclusive and diverse company culture.

• Pension and health benefits and bonus.

• Work-life balance - We truly believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of our self's, both in private life and as a colleague in the workplace.

• Empowerment - We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will involved in shaping our work processes.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavour to mitigate biases in our recruitment process. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

WHO WE ARE?  For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

jobs.occupation: Application Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Over one million Danes use Skatteguiden to understand and optimise their taxes. We automate tax tracking, surface deductions people didn't know they had, and give users the insight they need to make better financial decisions. All connected directly to the Danish tax authority. We're an independent company of around 50 people based in Copenhagen, with a 4.7-star rating and a simple mission: make financial insight accessible to everyone, not just those who can afford an accountant.

Our platform has grown with us. The infrastructure that keeps Skatteguiden running has reached a scale and complexity that deserves full-time, specialist ownership, and the work ahead makes this an unusually good time to join.

About the role

You'll be joining the Platform team as a Platform Application Engineer, the counterpart to our Operational Platform team, which owns the infrastructure. Where they own the systems that keep Skatteguiden running, you'll own the shared application-layer services that the rest of engineering depends on.

The team treats these services as a product, with engineers distributed across several product teams as their users. Every product team touches payments, identity, and integrations. Your job is to make those services reliable, well-designed, and genuinely easy to build on, across a microservices architecture that favours low coupling and event-driven communication over direct dependencies.

We operate on a simple principle: you build it, you own it. That means end-to-end accountability, from design and implementation through to what happens when something goes wrong. Incidents aren't escalated to someone else's queue; they're yours to understand, resolve, and learn from.

What you'll do

Own the shared application platform. Design and build the core backend services underpinning payments, identity, authorisation, and third-party integrations — the shared foundation that product teams rely on every day.

Build and maintain payment services. Design payment flows that are reliable, observable, and compliant. Work with product teams to support new features and providers without coupling concerns or creating fragility in the critical path.

Own identity and authorisation. Design the systems that manage who our users are and what they can do — from OAuth flows and token management to fine-grained permission models and audit trails.

Integrate security and privacy into the application layer. Work with our Head of Security & Privacy to translate requirements into technical controls — particularly in identity, authorisation, and data handling — with GDPR and ISO 27001 in mind.

Integrate third-party systems. Own the integration layer connecting messaging, payment providers, and others. Ensure resilience, observability, and clear contracts.

Improve the developer experience. Build shared libraries, abstractions, and internal tooling that make it easier for product engineers to build on top of platform services correctly and confidently. Reduce the cognitive load on teams that shouldn't need to think about auth or payment internals.

Who we're looking for

You're likely a senior backend or platform engineer who's built and operated shared application services at scale, and who sees that role not just as backend development but as a product discipline — with the engineers who depend on your services as your primary users.

You take end-to-end ownership seriously. You don't consider something done when the code is merged, you care about how it behaves in production, you're on the hook when it doesn't, and you treat incidents as feedback worth acting on.

You're genuinely collaborative, someone who makes the people around them better, shares context freely, and doesn't work in isolation. And you're curious: you like trying new things, you're not attached to the way things have always been done, and you get energy from learning.

Must-have

A senior backend or platform engineer who's built and operated shared application services at scale, writes clean, maintainable services, takes API design seriously, and cares about the boundaries between components.

Hands-on experience deploying and debugging services on Kubernetes in production; you know how to get code running reliably in a Kubernetes environment without needing to own the cluster.

Experience designing MySQL schemas for production, migrations, indexing, query performance, and keeping data models clean as requirements evolve.

Working knowledge of message brokers such as RabbitMQ, event-driven patterns, consumer reliability, and how to design async communication that is easy to reason about across a distributed codebase.

Understanding of identity and authorisation (OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, RBAC), and how to implement them securely and maintainably at scale.

Security, privacy, and compliance awareness. You design with GDPR, auditability, and least-privilege access in mind from the start, not as an afterthought.

A platform-as-a-product mindset. Experience thinking about developer experience as a product discipline, not just an engineering concern.

Genuine enthusiasm for AI. You use it daily, and you're always looking for new ways to apply it.

Nice-to-have

Experience building or operating payment integrations — familiarity with PSPs, webhook reliability, idempotency, and reconciliation.

Familiarity with React and TypeScript — enough to read, understand, and occasionally contribute to frontend code when the work calls for it.

Familiarity with Azure. You know your way around the platform — how services connect, how access and permissions work, and how to build in a cloud-native context.

Familiarity with our observability stack: Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry.

Familiarity with our GitOps tooling: ArgoCD and GitHub Actions.

Why join us

A substantial project from day one. The hosting migration means designing a production system from scratch, rare at any company.

Real influence. The architectural decisions made in this team will shape how Skatteguiden is built and operated for years. It's a small team with a high degree of autonomy, and the work is genuinely consequential.

Strong engineering culture. We take the technical foundations seriously. Security, architecture, and technical debt get real attention, not just lip service.

The product matters. Over one million Danes use Skatteguiden. Your work keeps it running and makes it possible to grow.

Solid company. We're independent, profitable, and growing. No VC pressure, no bloated roadmap. Just a clear mission and a team that cares.

A company that's serious about AI. We use AI across the business and we're only going deeper. Being a small, focused team means we can move fast on this, no lengthy approval chains, no slow rollouts. If you're always looking for ways to work smarter with AI, you'll fit right in.

Good people. We take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. The culture is professional, informal, and genuinely collaborative.

Practical details

Location: Copenhagen. We're an office-first company, and it's a deliberate choice. We're moving fast, we have big ambitions, and we genuinely believe that being physically together is one of the things that makes that possible. Things move quicker when you can turn your chair and talk to someone. We want to be upfront about this so you know what to expect.

And if we're asking people to be in the office, we want it to be worth their while. We're a five-minute walk from Rådhuspladsen, stocked with everything from fruit to fizzy drinks to afternoon snacks, and lunch is at Claus Meyer's canteen just across the street, proper food, not an afterthought. If you're putting in a long day, dinner is covered too.

Start: As soon as possible

Salary: Competitive and based on your experience.

Reporting to: CTO

Our lean hiring process

Screening call with our recruiter (30 min) ONLINE

Technical interview with the manager and an engineer (120 min) ONSITE

Meeting with our CEO (15 min) ONSITE

jobs.occupation: Business Consultant
jobs.description:
Business Consulting at Trackunit turns customer business problems into commercial outcomes on the Operating Data Platform, IrisX. The function sits between Sales and delivery: it owns the business case, shapes the commercial construct, and holds the line on what we promise and what we deliver.

We are not looking for someone who has seen it all. We are looking for someone who is ready to. Three to six years in, commercially curious, and hungry to own something real. You will work with enterprise construction, rental and OEM accounts across EMEA. Your job is to find the value they are not yet capturing, build the case for it at executive level, and make sure that value is realised after signature.

With locations in the hearts of EMEA, we offer you a flexible setup with the possibility to work from one of our locations in Denmark, Scandinavia, Germany and UK or remotely from anywhere in EMEA. No relocation assistance is offered for this position.

This role is ideal for someone with technical skills who is eager to make an impact in a growing market. We welcome junior candidates who are ready to learn and grow with us!

****What’s in it for you?

****Commercial ownership that is real, not symbolic. You are in the room with executives, customers and sales leadership, building the case, structuring the deal and shaping the decision. The role carries real commercial accountability from the first engagement, and your work shows up in outcomes, not just outputs.

A cross-functional role in the best sense of the word. You work daily across Sales, Customer Success, Solution Engineering and Product. Few roles give that breadth of view or that ability to get things done across a business.

A function still being built. The Business Consulting playbook is not finished. What you learn from customers shapes how the team works and what the product prioritises. The best ideas here do not die in a document.

Time with customers. You will be on the ground with customers across EMEA, building relationships over years rather than over calls. It also means you need to be someone who finds energy in that, not someone who tolerates it.

• A place in an agile growth SaaS business, with possibilities to grow internally in the company. We are moving quickly, so fasten your seat belt and prepare to adjust. Back in 2020 we were 150 employees at Trackunit and we have just passed 450 employees.

• International environment with regular check-ins and social events across teams, departments and borders.

• We take your personal and professional development goals seriously and we support them through training, coaching and mindfulness as well as with an open feedback culture to enable you to identify your strengths and opportunities. We do this by touching upon your impact on our triple focus: impacting yourself, impacting teams/relations and impacting the organisation/strategy.

• Flexibility and hybrid working is not just a cliché to us or something we state in a job posting. We do offer you a flexible setup and believe that you best can structure how your routines look like. And once you have chosen how you work best, let us know what you need: we got you covered with the IT equipment you need for your work.

• Turning the Tide. At Trackunit, we aim to create and contribute to an inclusive workplace. And this priority starts with our hiring. We do not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, sexual orientation, personal expression, ethnicity, religious belief, or disability status. We only assess candidates on their qualifications and merit. Learn more about TIDE and other DE&I initiatives here.

****Who are you ideally?

****This is a high-trajectory role, not a senior one. We are looking for someone three to six years into a career in SaaS, consulting, customer success or a commercial function, with a track record that already stands out.

• You have built a business case and defended it in front of people who pushed back, and it held.

• You read a P&L, understand how SaaS and consumption-based pricing create value, and can explain it to a CFO.

• You get things done across functions without formal authority. You influence through credibility and trust.

• You operate well in ambiguity. Priorities shift, the platform evolves and customer expectations do not always match reality. You stay composed and find the path forward.

• You are curious about technology and can hold a credible conversation with product and engineering.

• You think in terms of the team’s result and are clear about your own contribution to it.

• You will Travel regularly to customers. The role requires it.

Don't meet every single requirement? No worries - this is what we're looking for ideally, but if you're super excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Lead customer engagements from discovery through adoption and expansion, connecting business needs to platform capability.

• Build and present business cases to senior stakeholders, including commercial modelling and value articulation at executive level.

• Partner with Sales on complex deals, shaping pricing and consumption-based commercial structures that require both commercial and technical fluency.

• Work across Sales, Solution Engineering, Product and Customer Success so the customer experiences one joined-up journey rather than a chain of hand-offs.

• Translate platform change into clear, honest communication with customers and set expectations we can meet.

• Convert what you learn into frameworks and documentation that raise the standard of the whole team.

• Run multiple active engagements in parallel without compromising relationships or delivery quality.

jobs.occupation: RevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
A few years into RevOps, most people end up choosing between staying close to admin and reporting, or moving towards building automations and the AI tools that now sit on top of the CRM. The second path is hard to get onto if you haven't done it somewhere first.

In this job you'd do both, in a commercial team that already works with AI day to day through assistants connected to Salesforce, support tickets and product data, while marketing is being rebuilt the same way. You'd build on that, starting next to the person who set most of it up and taking over the technical side from them. You'd also keep the CRM and the data underneath it in good order. That's a lot of upkeep, like permissions, data cleanup and renewal notices to thousands of customers, and there's no ops team to share it with.

Airtame makes wireless screen-sharing devices and the cloud software that manages them, used in schools and workplaces around the world. Most of our volume goes through distributors on several continents, sometimes to customers our own reps sent them. Our sales team also works deals directly, and smaller orders come through our Shopify store. Running all three through one Salesforce makes for a harder data model than most RevOps roles come with.

We're around 55 people, headquartered in Copenhagen, and we'd prefer you to work from the office there. Remote from elsewhere in the EU works too. You'd report to our Director of Customer Experience & Revenue Operations, who sets the roadmap with you and owns the metric definitions, and you'd work with sales, customer experience, marketing and product every week.

What Success Looks Like (Year 1)

Own the Commercial Stack: By the end of the year the technical side has moved over to you, including the AI tools the team uses. You bring the roadmap to your manager and build it, and when sales or support want a system changed, you decide how it's done.

Send the Right Renewal Message: Thousands of customers receive renewal notices. We're starting to ask customers in our cloud software how they intend to renew, and you'd build the email flows that act on it, with a separate path for each way of renewing. If a notice doesn't go out, you know within hours.

Make the Numbers Agree: Pipeline, bookings, ARR, renewals and churn come out the same in every dashboard and every AI assistant, whether the sale came through Shopify, a rep or a distributor. Your manager sets the definitions, and you make sure every system uses them.

Automate the Manual Work: Find the processes worth automating and keep shipping them, tested in a sandbox first with a way back if something goes wrong. The first one is turning the pricing claims our distributors send, in all sorts of formats, into line-item pricing in Salesforce with an audit trail. As AI assistants get better at connecting to things on their own, part of this is also deciding what's still worth building ourselves.

Bring Support onto Intercom: We're moving customer support from Zendesk to Intercom. Depending on when you join, you'd help finish the move or pick it up just after go-live, then own Intercom, including its Salesforce sync and the AI setup that gets customer feedback to the product team.

Who You Are

• You know Salesforce from the inside. A few years of hands-on admin, including Flow Builder, permissions and the data model. You write SQL and SOQL and can model data for a report yourself.

• You ask why before you build. You can tell us about a request you pushed back on, or a process you changed or dropped instead of automating it as asked, and what it was for in the first place.

• You work with AI by default. You use AI tools every day to write flows and queries, and you keep up with what's new on your own. When a new connector makes something we built unnecessary, you're happy to retire it. If you've connected tools through their APIs or written some Python or JavaScript, that's a strong plus.

• You've run a commercial system on your own. At some point you've been the only or main admin of a Salesforce org or a similar system, and you left documentation behind that someone else could take over from. Here there's no ops team behind you, so a broken sync in the morning and a dashboard request in the afternoon are both yours.

Why Airtame?

• Building on Top of Admin: You'd keep the CRM running and build automations and AI tooling on top of it, starting next to the person who set most of it up.

• Most RevOps roles are purely SaaS or purely e-commerce. Here, you get to solve the unique intellectual challenge of bridging a hardware supply chain with a high-velocity digital subscription model.

• A healthy work-life balance.

• Five weeks paid vacation and 5 days of extra paid AirtameFlex days.

• Pension and private health insurance (on FTE Copenhagen contract).

• Flexible work environment, with a hybrid mindset.

• Catered lunch in the office.

Airtame is an equal opportunity employer. We have colleagues across the globe, with both in-office and full-time remote workers. This feeds into our international hybrid mindset, with people from 25+ nationalities that make up the Airtame team.

Our work-life cultural balance is key to our success. Our team encompasses our values of trust and open communication to support each other and to collaborate in a fun and collective way.

**How We Handle Your Application Data

**Airtame ApS (CVR 35478973, Copenhagen), together with Airtame US Inc. for US roles, processes the information you submit to assess your application. We do this under the EU General Data Protection Regulation, wherever you are based. Your data is stored in Greenhouse, our recruiting system, which may store it outside the EU under standard EU safeguards. Only the people involved in hiring can see it. For roles with privileged access to our systems, we’ll contact one professional reference or previous employer that you name, to confirm your role and dates. We’ll tell you before we do. We keep your data for 6 months after the recruitment process ends, or longer where US law requires it or where you consent to us keeping it for future roles. To get a copy of your data, correct or delete it, or object to how we use it, write to data@airtame.com. You can also complain to the Danish Data Protection Agency (Datatilsynet).

jobs.occupation: Holistic Account Manager | Aarhus, Denmark
jobs.description:
Build the next version of Mapon

****Mapon builds B2B SaaS for companies whose work happens in the physical world. Our platform helps businesses manage vehicles, drivers, and equipment, improve road safety, reduce costs, automate daily operations, and comply with complex transport regulations.

We started in Riga in 2006. Today, more than 35,000 clients use Mapon, with over 400,000 connected devices on the platform. We have 200+ colleagues across Europe and a network of 150+ partners worldwide. In 2025, Mapon grew revenue by 22.8% to 24.2 million EUR while remaining profitable. We have completed eight acquisitions and intend to keep growing organically and through M&A.

****Working at Mapon Denmark

****At the Mapon Danish branch, you'll join a local team of 9 colleagues. You'll have your closest teammates nearby, while also working with colleagues across our eight branches and beyond, sharing market insights and helping grow one product across different countries. It's the best of both worlds: a strong local team and a genuinely international way of working.

We're looking for an Holistic Account Manager in Denmark to grow sales within a portfolio of 200+ existing customer accounts. Your primary focus will be identifying and closing upsell and cross-sell opportunities. Account Management is a core growth function for us.

****Your mission

****This is a sales role focused on existing customers. You'll grow your portfolio's recurring revenue by selling additional solutions and expanding customers' use of Mapon. Retaining customers and managing commercial relationships are also part of your responsibility.

You'll use CRM, revenue and product usage data to decide which customers to contact and where to invest your time. You'll lead commercial conversations and turn customer needs into sales opportunities.

Managing 200+ accounts requires structure and deliberate prioritisation. You'll combine focused work with high-potential customers with regular outreach and follow-up across the wider portfolio.

We'll teach you the product and the industry. You bring commercial drive, relationship skills and a disciplined approach to managing your work.

****The challenges you'll tackle

****Our customers operate across transport, logistics, construction, delivery, and other industries. They have different priorities, fleet sizes, and levels of experience with our products.

Some need help making better use of what they already have. Others could benefit from additional solutions or wider adoption across their business. Some may be at risk of leaving before they tell us anything is wrong.

Your challenge is to understand those differences and focus your effort where it matters most. You'll need to balance customer needs, retention risks, and growth opportunities across your portfolio.

You'll also work across internal teams to make sure customer commitments turn into action.

**What You'll Own And Do

**You'll own customer relationships, retention, and recurring revenue growth across your assigned portfolio.

• Prioritise and manage your portfolio. Use customer data to plan outreach across 200+ accounts and focus effort where the commercial impact is greatest. Develop detailed account plans for selected high-value or high-potential customers.

• Own the sales process within your portfolio. Proactively identify customer needs and recommend relevant solutions. Prepare offers, negotiate and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities.

• Build a pipeline from existing customers. Turn customer conversations and data into qualified opportunities. Maintain clear next steps and follow through until a decision is made.

• Build adoption and value. Help customers understand the business value of relevant Mapon solutions and identify opportunities for wider use.

• Manage retention risks. Recognise declining engagement, unresolved issues or changing requirements early. Lead the commercial response and involve the right team when specialist help is needed.

• Prepare for renewals. Start commercial conversations early, contribute to renewal planning and negotiate with long-term value in mind.

• Maintain a reliable view of your portfolio. Keep CRM records and opportunities current. Use customer and product usage data to prioritise work and forecast results.

• Coordinate internally. Work with Growth, Product, Support, Technicians and Finance to move sales opportunities forward and deliver on customer commitments. Keep ownership of commercial next steps while specialists handle their areas.

• Represent the customer internally. Share useful feedback, surface customer stories and identify opportunities for referrals.

You own the commercial relationship and sales opportunities. Our Support team handles technical questions and troubleshooting directly with customers.

Your focus is proactive sales, renewals and retention. You are not expected to serve as the technical help desk for your portfolio.

When a technical issue puts a customer relationship or sale at risk, you work with Support on the customer impact and commercial next steps. Support owns the technical investigation and resolution.

**What Success Looks Like

**

• Your portfolio's recurring revenue grows through upsell and cross-sell while losses from cancellations and reduced spending are kept under control.

• You build and close a healthy pipeline of opportunities within your existing customer base.

• You maintain consistent outreach and follow-up across your portfolio. More time goes to the strongest growth opportunities and material retention risks.

• Customer risks are identified early, with clear actions and follow-through.

• Your opportunities and forecasts are grounded in customer conversations and reliable CRM data.

• Customers understand the value of the solutions they buy and know where to get technical support.

• You contribute practical improvements to how Mapon manages and grows existing accounts.

**What We're Looking For

**You're likely to be a strong fit if you have:

• Experience in B2B account management, sales or customer success, with clear examples of closing sales and growing revenue from existing customers.

• Confidence in proactive outreach, upselling, cross-selling and negotiation.

• The ability to understand a customer's business and connect their needs with relevant solutions.

• Experience managing a large customer portfolio through segmentation, structured outreach and disciplined follow-up.

• Experience using CRM and customer data to prioritise sales opportunities and identify retention risks.

• Clear communication and the ability to build trust with customers and colleagues.

SaaS or subscription business experience is useful. So is a background in telematics, fleet management, logistics, mobility, or IoT. Neither is required—we're ready to help you learn the industry and our products.

**How You Operate

**

• You take ownership. You follow through on commitments and keep people informed.

• You are commercially curious. You want to understand how customers work, what they value and where growth can come from.

• You initiate sales conversations. You actively create opportunities within your portfolio and are comfortable asking for the business.

• You act early. You reach out before a renewal becomes urgent or a customer issue escalates.

• You prioritise deliberately. You use data and commercial judgement to decide where your time will have the greatest impact.

• You communicate honestly. You raise difficult issues, set realistic expectations and address problems directly.

• You work across teams. You involve the right specialists and stay accountable for commercial progress.

**Compensation

**A competitive, stable base salary plus an uncapped performance bonus. Every bit of new monthly recurring revenue you close through upselling and cross-selling flows straight into your bonus, so your earnings grow with your results. There's no ceiling.

We'll walk you through the full bonus structure, targets and payout schedule during the recruitment process.

**Additionally We Offer

**Join an international team of 200+ colleagues with global reach and local soul.

Partly subsided lunch at the office.

♀ Hybrid work setup – work from home or in a cozy office in Galten (mainly work is organized from the office).

Access to paid AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and others when useful for your work.

Social events, team buildings, and a supportive work culture.

Laptop, accessories, and everything you need.

Extra day off on your birthday.

Annual training budget.

Flexible hours to enjoy life outside work.

Health Days— take time off when you're not feeling well, without the need for a sick leave certificate;

Referral bonus — receive a reward when you refer a candidate who successfully joins our team;

Join a friendly, supportive team where you'll thrive, with a well-planned onboarding process starting from day one to ensure your success.

****Hiring process

• CV review – Your application will be reviewed by HR and the Hiring Manager (Head of Holistic Accounts Management).

• Pre-recorded interview (Testlify) – Selected candidates will be invited to complete a pre-recorded interview via Testlify (in video format) to answer questions and test language knowledge, allowing you to answer at a time that suits you best.

• Online interview – interview with the Hiring Manager and HR (up to 60min).

• Background check - References from previous employers.

If you enjoy building long-term customer relationships and taking responsibility for their commercial growth, we'd like to hear from you.

This is your chance to be part of something meaningful, grow your skills, and make your mark in a dynamic and future-focused company. ****Apply now and let's shape the future of telematics – together.

• We provide detailed feedback on interview performance and/or the technical task only to candidates who have reached the final stage of the selection process.

Foreign employees working temporarily in Denmark may be eligible for certain tax deductions, depending on their individual tax situation.

 Travel between your home country and Denmark

Double-household deduction

If your employment in Denmark is temporary and you maintain a home both in Denmark and in your home country, you may, under certain conditions, qualify for a deduction for additional household expenses. This may apply when your work requires you to live away from your permanent home.

To qualify, your employment must generally be temporary, and the distance between the two homes must make daily travel unreasonable. The deduction may be available for up to two years.

For 2026, the standard deduction for double housekeeping is DKK 400 per week without documentation. A higher deduction may be possible if you can document your actual expenses. The total deduction for food, accommodation and double housekeeping is subject to an annual maximum of DKK 34,400 for 2026. 

Important: These deductions are not automatic. You are responsible for checking whether you qualify and for entering the relevant deductions on your Danish tax assessment. Keep your documentation in case the Danish Tax Agency requests it.

jobs.occupation: Tenure Track Assistant Professor in Digitalization
jobs.description:
Copenhagen Business School invites applications for one or more vacant Assistant Professorship (s) in Information Systems and Digitalization at the Department of Digitalization.

CBS is a globally recognized business school with a robust interdisciplinary and collaborative research environment. The Department of Digitalization is an engaged and diverse community of scholars exploring the interplay between technology and organizations, with impact-driven research and teaching at its core. Our main research areas include (but not exclusively):

1. Business intelligence and data science

2. Data studies

3. Digital ecosystem and sustainability

4. Digital government

5. IT management and enterprise architecture

6. Hybrid threats and defence tech

7. Digital transformation of work and society

We prioritize high-quality research and are committed to publishing in leading academic journals, with a particular focus on the AIS premier journal list (https://aisnet.org/research/seniorscholarsbasket/ ).

Teaching responsibilities of the department comprise undergraduate and graduate teaching in Digitalization, please read more about our programmes: https://www.cbs.dk/en/research/departments-and-centres/ department-of-digitalization/ degree-programmes

We are interested in candidates with a PhD in Information Systems and Digitalization, ideally with a strong technical background (e.g., MSc in Computer Science, Data Science, or related fields).

Candidates are expected to have a promising research pipeline and a commitment to contribute to advancing scholarship in the fields of information systems and digitalization.

We are particularly interested in candidates who can teach following subjects:

• 
Data science, Artificial Intelligence, and their mathematical and computational foundations (e.g., linear algebra, machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing)

• 
Cyber security

• 
Enterprise architecture

The assistant professorship is a tenure track position (6 years) with research and teaching obligations.

To fulfil the research requirements of the position, the applicant(s) chosen is expected to be physically present on a regular basis and actively participate in the teaching and research activities of the Department. The successful applicant is obliged to participate in the assistant professor program at CBS on teaching principles and methods in order to fulfil the pedagogical requirements made at the end of the term of employment as assistant professor.

Responsibilities 

• 
Teaching and associated examination in existing CBS programs, including Executive Education

• 
Individual and group based research meeting high international standards

• 
Promoting CBS’s academic reputation

• 
Initiating, fund raising and coordinating research projects

• 
Promoting the teaching and research capabilities of Copenhagen Business School and other relevant assignments at Copenhagen Business School

• 
Contributing to the administrative responsibilities of the department and to CBS-wide tasks

• 
Communicating findings to the public in general and to CBS’s stakeholders in particular

• 
Research, including responsibility for the academic development of the relevant discipline

• 
Responsibility for publishing, scientific communication and research-based teaching

• 
Active participation in the regular research activities, such as research seminars, workshops and conferences.

The assistant professor is expected to contribute to the development and application of the research of the department’s research areas and to maintain and strengthen CBS’s international research position. 

Qualification 

The applicant must hold a PhD or the equivalent. Emphasis is placed on the applicant’s research potential, which means that a researcher with a large research potential may be preferred to a researcher with a large research production. 

The applicant must have professional proficiency in English (written and spoken). 

Copenhagen Business School has a broad commitment to the excellence, distinctiveness and relevance of its teaching and research programmes. Candidates who wish to join us should demonstrate enthusiasm for working in an organisation of this type.

For further information please contact: Head of Department Andrea Carugati via e-mail ac.digi@cbs.dk. Information about the department may be found at www.cbs.dk/digi.

Appointment and salary will be in accordance with the Ministry of Finance’s agreement with the Central Academic Organisation.

Application 

Application must be sent via the electronic recruitment system.

Application must include: 

• 
A statement of application.

• 
Proof of qualifications and a full CV.

• 
Documentation of relevant, significant, original research at an international level, including publications in the field’s internationally recognized journals and citations in the Social Science Citation Index and/or Google Scholar.

• 
A teaching portfolio documenting teaching qualifications and pedagogical development. The portfolio must include an overview of the applicants past teaching achievements and practice and its impact on the students, reflections on pedagogical competencies and core strengths, the educational competencies the applicant would like to develop, and the teaching opportunities they would like to pursue in the nearest future. External applicants can see the full description of the teaching portfolio here. Internal applicants must use the CBS Teaching Portfolio format. It is available at www.share.cbs.dk. Please make a pdf of each of the spreadsheets from part B of the portfolio.

• 
Information indicating experience in research management, industry co-operation and international co-operation.

• 
A complete, numbered list of publications (indicating titles, co-authors, page numbers and year) with an * marking of the academic productions to be considered during the review. A maximum of 10 publications for review are allowed. Applicants are requested to prioritise their publications in relation to the field of this job advertisement.

• 
Copies of the publications marked with an *. Only publications written in English (or another specified principal language, according to research tradition) or one of the Scandinavian languages will be taken into consideration.

Recruitment procedure 

The Recruitment Committee will shortlist minimum two applicants; when possible five or more applicants will be shortlisted. The shortlisted applicants will be assessed by the Assessment Committee. All applicants will be notified of their status in the recruitment process shortly after the application deadline.

The applicants selected for assessment will be notified about the composition of the Assessment Committee and later in the process about the result of the assessment.

Once the recruitment process is completed each applicant will be notified of the outcome of their application.

Copenhagen Business School must receive all application material, including all appendices (see items above), by the application deadline.

Copenhagen Business School invites all qualified candidates to apply for the position. An appointment committee will review the applications and invite a selection of qualified candidates to an interview.

One of CBS’ strategic goals is the promotion of diversity, which is why every effort has been made to ensure a recruitment process that reduces potential bias. Applicants are therefore encouraged not to include a photo or unnecessary personal information in their application.

Details about Copenhagen Business School and the department are available at www.cbs.dk.
